beats.label: The study
beats.text: **12,772** adults in Brazil, followed for about **8** **years.**
beats.note: Suemoto et al., Neurology 2025 (Univ. of São Paulo)

beats.label: What they tracked
beats.text: Seven low- and no-calorie sweeteners, including **aspartame,** **erythritol** and **xylitol.**

beats.label: The finding
beats.text: The highest users showed **62%** faster decline in thinking and memory than the lowest.

beats.label: Put another way
beats.text: About **1.6** **extra** **years** of cognitive aging, based on test scores.

beats.label: Who stood out
beats.text: The link showed up in people **under** **60,** and was **stronger** with **diabetes.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: An **association** from **self-reported** diet, not proof of harm. Have diabetes? Ask your **doctor** before switching.
